sentences.text: The allegation against the petitioner is that he tried to switch ATM Card from the informant.
When the informant raised alarm he tried to escape but was finally caught by the public.
4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has stated that there are incriminating materials in the Case Diary against the petitioner.
5. I have perused the Case Diary.
Indeed there are incriminating materials in the Case Diary against the petitioner.
However, investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.

I have considered the submission on behalf of the petitioner that he is willing to cooperate with the remaining part of the investigation and to abide by any stringent bail conditions if imposed upon him.
It appears that further custodial detention may not be required for the progress of investigation.
I have also considered the submission on behalf of the petitioner that his wife is pregnant and today is her due date.
6. Considering all aspects and in view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the conditions:
i) The petitioner shall refrain from such activities with which he is alleged.
ii) The petitioner shall cooperate with the investigation.
7. On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand cancelled.
8. In the above terms, this Bail Application stands disposed of.

Send back the Case Diary.
